name: Annie Flash
description: Annie Flash is a retired outlaw and sharpshooter of the Atiin on Thunder Junction, whose golden eye sees through illusions.

description_citations.text: "Annie Flash". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

description_citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
description_citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

summary.text: Annie Flash is a retired outlaw and sharpshooter of the Atiin on Thunder Junction, whose golden eye sees through illusions.

citations.text: "Annie Flash". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

bio.text: After the Freestriders robbed Akul and the Hellspurs, Akul hunted them and nearly killed her nephew Tommy with his venom, so she took Tommy into her care and quit the gang.

citations.text: "Annie Flash", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Annie Flash", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tommy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Oko recruited her for a heist against Akul because she can see through illusions, and she joined him only as far as stopping Akul.

citations.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

bio.text: She helped break Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa out of the Sterling Company's cells, and she rescued Nolan from the train.

citations.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nolan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At Tarnation she, Oko, Kellan and Vraska were captured and Akul took the final piece of the key.

citations.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Inside the vault she shot at Oko and deliberately missed, and Jace, disguised as Ashiok, put her to sleep.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.
"Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: As the vault collapsed, Kellan controlled Akul's mind and sent him into it so Annie could escape.

citations.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Annie is alive, and weeks after the heist Kellan was working on her ranch; Tommy has left Thunder Junction for the Atiin home plane.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.
"Tommy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Annie Flash follows the smoke on Fortune, recognises Akul's work in the burned carriage and finds an untouched lockbox of cash.
timeline.quote: A lockbox sat inside, untouched.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie deduces that the Hellspurs left the money because they were after something bigger.
timeline.quote: But they left the money behind—which meant they were after something else.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie brings the lockbox to Mr. Towning and they split the cash fifty-fifty.
timeline.quote: Annie watched him divide the cash into two equal parts.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko, disguised as a city man, approaches Annie on her porch and she sees through his illusion with her golden eye.
timeline.quote: My name is Oko—and your ability to see through illusions is exactly why I've been looking for you.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko offers Annie revenge by recruiting her for a heist against Akul, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko leaves a saloon matchbook and hints that the Hellspurs could easily find her town.
timeline.quote: If it was this easy for me to find you, imagine how easy it will be if the Hellspurs ever decide to come looking.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie realises her old ghosts have followed her to the only place she cares about.
timeline.quote: her old ghosts had followed her to the only place left in the world that she truly cared about.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Unable to sleep after Oko's threat to her town, Annie digs up her buried thunder rifle.
timeline.quote: pulled the lid back to reveal her thunder rifle.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie summons Fortune and rides to Rustwood following Oko's matchbook.
timeline.quote: Annie took Oko's matchbook from her pocket and looked at the black lettering once more.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie meets Breeches, Malcolm and Tinybones at the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko is waiting behind the bar.
timeline.quote: "Care for a drink?" Oko's voice sounded from behind the bar.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie agrees to join the crew, but only as far as stopping Akul.
timeline.quote: "I'm in—but only as far as stopping Akul."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko announces the crew will rob Maag Taranau, a vault Annie thought a myth.
timeline.quote: "We're going to rob Maag Taranau," he said at last.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears and explains they hired the crew to break into the vault, which Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
timeline.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko explains that Bertram Graywater holds the key and that the courier Akul chased was a decoy.
timeline.quote: he had Akul halfway across the desert chasing a decoy courier

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko says the first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters, where two team members are imprisoned and the key is held; Rakdos arrives.
timeline.quote: Our first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters,

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Eriette dissolves a vent grate with Breeches's potion and charms the prison guards while Annie slips past.
timeline.quote: Eriette stepped forward and whispered a spell under her breath

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie sees through the illusions hiding Kaervek and Umezawa in their cells and Eriette frees them.
timeline.quote: Kaervek was on one side of the room; Satoru Umezawa was on the other.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie leaves Jody Carpenter's bed in Saddlebrush, turning down his offer to stay.
timeline.quote: "Sorry, Jordan. I got my own bed to keep warm."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie glimpses a slithering shadow near the dunes but dismisses it as paranoia.
timeline.quote: Annie catches movement in the distance, a slithering shadow crawling through her periphery.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie returns to her farm and checks in with Fortune, then goes to her sick nephew Tommy.
timeline.quote: Tommy is in bed when she walks in his room, awake and staring out the window.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie gives Tommy blue smoke for his pain, and keeps watch by his bed all night.
timeline.quote: "Here." She holds the bottle under his nose and uncorks it

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie finds a picnic basket on her stoop that appeared overnight without her hearing anyone.
timeline.quote: There's a basket waiting on her stoop that sure as sin wasn't there the night before

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Jody denies leaving the basket and tells Annie the townspeople are worried about her.
timeline.quote: "People 'round here are worried about y'all, out there all alone."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A giant rattlewurm slithers through Saddlebrush, sending townspeople fleeing, then leaves without hurting anyone.
timeline.quote: an enormous rattlewurm slithers through the streets of Saddlebrush.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The rattlewurm envenoms Mira, and Annie gives her blue smoke.
timeline.quote: Annie hardly knows what she's doing before she's doing it

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie volunteers to kill the rattlewurm and Bo offers to come along; she sets out at dawn the next day.
timeline.quote: "I'll kill the thing."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie tells Tommy she is leaving to hunt the rattlewurm, and he refuses medicine, saying he is tired all the time.
timeline.quote: "Tired … all the time."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tommy appears with a walking stick and tells Bo to bring his aunt back.
timeline.quote: "You come back with my aunt. Or you don't come back. You hear me?"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie uses her enhanced vision to find the rattlewurm's lair and sees a baby rattlewurm joining it.
timeline.quote: another rattlewurm emerges. This one is considerably smaller.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie decides not to slaughter the rattlewurms, and instead corrals them deeper into the dunes, which the townsfolk accept.
timeline.quote: for corralling them deeper into the dunes where prey was more plentiful and people scarcer

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tommy tells Annie he is leaving for home and real medicine, with arrangements made through Jody.
timeline.quote: "Back to our people."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tommy embraces Annie, calling her Haseya, and tells her he loves her before leaving.
timeline.quote: I couldn't hate you. I love you.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie concludes that she can build a community but will still be alone with her ghosts at night.
timeline.quote: it's always gonna be Annie Flash and her ghosts.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie names an Outcaster named Nolan who can read the artifact, and Vraska says he is on a train to Prosperity under Sterling guard.
timeline.quote: "The man in question is currently on a train to Prosperity, escorted by Sterling mercenaries."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
timeline.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko overrules Kellan about helping Umezawa and orders Annie to blow up the bridge.
timeline.quote: Oko's jaw tensed. "Take it out."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie arrives on Fortune and carries Nolan and Umezawa away from the train.
timeline.quote: Annie steered Fortune toward safety and broke into a fearless gallop

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie returns and holds off the Sterling riders while the passengers jump from the train.
timeline.quote: each of them nervously jumping for the desert floor before fleeing as far from the train as possible.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan releases his vines and the train plunges off the cliff and explodes; Annie and Kellan escape on Fortune.
timeline.quote: Kellan released his vines with a gasp, and the train shot over the edge of the cliff

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie and Kellan agree to escort Nolan to an oasis so he can make his way home.
timeline.quote: I can go with Kellan and escort the Outcaster to the nearest oasis.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie tells Kellan how Akul hunted the Freestriders and injured her nephew, and why she cannot let him get the vault's power.
timeline.quote: A while back, I was with the Freestriders.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko plans to enter Tarnation disguised as Hellspurs with Vraska, Annie and Kellan to reach Akul.
timeline.quote: We'll split up the team and take a small group of four into the city,

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The infiltration team enters Tarnation, where Hellspurs duel openly.
timeline.quote: A small crowd jeered and roared, and when one of the axes landed in the other man's chest, the onlookers raised their arms in triumph.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie identifies Twist Fandango, one of Akul's crew, in a saloon.
timeline.quote: "That's Twist Fandango. One of Akul's crew."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Twist Fandango and Akul's inner circle capture Oko, Kellan, Annie and Vraska.
timeline.quote: clamping a pair of iron cuffs to his wrists.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul mocks Annie about her nephew and says he will watch them suffer.
timeline.quote: How is that nephew of yours?

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul confronts the chained crew, takes the sixth key from Oko and assembles the full key in his medallion.
timeline.quote: Akul slotted the sixth key into the medallion

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan challenges Akul to a duel; Oko and the others goad Akul's pride until he agrees to a duel at midnight.
timeline.quote: The duel begins at midnight.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: At midnight Kellan is brought to Tarnation's dueling grounds, while Oko, Vraska and Annie are chained in the stands.
timeline.quote: Oko, Vraska, and Annie appeared, still bound in chains.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tinybones frees the crew with a key, and Vraska petrifies the Hellspurs guarding them; Oko reveals he planned this.
timeline.quote: locked eyes with one after another until all of them were stone.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko admits to Annie and Vraska that he leaked Tarnation's coordinates to Graywater to use the raid as a distraction, and that he brought Kellan because he knew he would get them caught.
timeline.quote: I brought Kellan with us because I knew he'd get us caught.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko refuses to go back for Kellan and Annie reluctantly goes on to the vault.
timeline.quote: There was no time for a rescue mission tonight.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko's reunited crew enters Maag Taranau, with the silent Annie leading them through traps.
timeline.quote: Annie's left iris glowed a vivid orange as she approached the outer entrance.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Umezawa explains the dual-lever trap, and Tinybones is guided across the light grid with a dragonfly device.
timeline.quote: Annie did a few practice turns in the air before sending the dragonfly to the edge of the platform.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie shoots Oko, purposely missing, and Kellan uses his fae magic as Ashiok's nightmares overwhelm them.
timeline.quote: Shadows moved across the floor, wrapping around not only Kellan but Annie and Ral, too.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's illusion drops, revealing Jace Beleren, who puts Annie to sleep.
timeline.quote: The darkness evaporated, and beneath Ashiok's hooded cloak was Jace Beleren.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes to find Vraska, Jace and the child gone and the vault collapsing, and rescues Annie.
timeline.quote: By the time he reached her side, Vraska, the man, and the child had vanished without a trace.
